key_facts.reason_jp: 本公開買付価格の妥当性に関する説明内容の訂正

summary_en: Correction to August 19, 2026 MBO announcement regarding premium calculation methodology. The offer price of 2,970 yen represents premiums of 3.81% to 26.54% over various reference periods, lower than median premiums of 41.8% to 48.0% in comparable MBO transactions since June 2019, but justified by the company's elevated PBR exceeding 10x and recent upward stock price trend.
summary_jp: 2026年8月19日のMBO公表内容の訂正。買付価格2,970円は基準日終値に対し3.81%～6ヶ月平均に対し26.54%のプレミアムを付与。他社MBO事例の中央値41.8～48.0%より低いが、当社のPBR10倍超と直近の株価上昇傾向を踏まえると妥当と説明。

summary_en: BCPE Neon Cayman LP launched tender offer for all ordinary shares and outstanding warrants (2nd–7th tranches) of Baudroie at ¥3,600 per share. Tender period: 31 business days (19 Aug – 5 Oct 2026). Warrants to be acquired at prices to be determined separately. Treasury shares excluded.
summary_jp: BCPE Neon Cayman LPがボードルア普通株式および全新株予約権（第2～7回）を公開買付け。1株当たり3,600円。買付期間：31営業日（2026年8月19日～10月5日）。自己株式除く。

summary_en: Tender offer by BCPE Neon Cayman, L.P. to acquire baudroie (4413) at ¥2,970/share, minimum 3,135,200 shares. Warrants (series 2–7) at ¥1 each. Period: Aug 19 – Oct 5, 2026 (31 business days). Board recommends acceptance; intended to make company wholly owned and delist from TSE Prime. Three incumbent executives (Shigekane Tominaga, Kazuya Fujii, Yoshiaki Hodoshima) committed to remain post-completion.
summary_jp: BCPE Neon Cayman, L.P.による公開買付。普通株式1株につき金2,970円、最低取得予定数3,135,200株。新株予約権（第2～7回）1個につき金1円。期間：2026年8月19日～10月5日（31営業日）。取締役会は応募を推奨。非公開化・上場廃止予定。経営陣3名（冨永重寛、藤井和也、程島義明）が完全子会社化後も経営に関与予定。
